# GSQ224 image instruction regression and exact one-row batch cost rejection

The fixed image screen reuses all eight existing fixtures, their original images and unchanged exact graders. Two sequential sessions use the same source-bound executable, complete 32K window, two streamed drafts, prefix reset per case and a 14.5-GB physical ceiling. Actual preflight is 20.5 GB with continuing three-GB headroom. No new corpus, weight, raw logit or paid compute is created.

V1 stops on a nonexistent Python helper before output creation or model launch. V2 uses the correct read/digest API but stops before launch because the historical helper double-counts verified hardlinks. V3 uses the existing current performance method, du allocated bytes, against the same 430-GB physical staging limit. No prompt, score, native setting or resource ceiling is relaxed. Both predecessor failures and all frozen code follow.

V3 completes all sixteen case outcomes and forty-eight answers. Original passes eight of eight cases and all twenty-four turns. GSQ224 passes four of eight cases and twenty of twenty-four turns. All four new failures are response-format errors: three bar-count answers are the bare number 3, and the solid-green answer is the bare word green. Each semantic value is correct, but the requested object with only the answer key is absent. Do not describe these as miscounted bars or visual recognition mistakes. This instruction-following loss fails the frozen no-new-turn-regression rule. Original peak physical footprint is 12,246,179,544 bytes; candidate peaks and all raw sessions are recorded below. These are functional/quality observations, not clean speed measurements or broad statistical equivalence.

Reject this exact GSQ224 recipe for full-product and Auto admission. Retain its useful text evidence and authenticated source for reproducibility; do not claim a general failure of calibrated two-bit quantization. Cancel the prepared higher-budget pilot and the remaining representative confirmation cell because more speed data cannot repair this quality gate. Their five completed speed cells and two preflight refusals remain intact. No final missing-cell protocol or fourteen-GB run is launched after this result. A materially different, prospectively specified quality-preserving recipe or a separately owner-approved product-scope change would be needed to reopen admission. Do not tune against these eight fixtures.

The independent kernel screen compares the actual current concatenated one-row quantized operations with a batch of M=1 operations on the same six authenticated dense matrices at one, three and five rows. All eighteen cells are finite and bit-exact. Five alternating timing rounds of forty dependent iterations rotate at least 256 MiB of weight buffers per shape. Timing is eligible under the frozen strict component rule. Some five-row operations improve, but lm_head costs 1.225 times current at three rows and 1.301 times at five. No primary matrix satisfies the required ten-percent gain at both row counts, and the no-regression condition fails. The 21.302-second component run earns no native or product implementation. Preserve the positive exactness observation and negative cost result; do not remove the vocabulary head after seeing the outcome or claim net model acceleration by summing isolated timers.

These failures leave the original as the sole supported pack. The same-checkpoint twenty-token target is still unmet at the smaller measured budgets, and there is no qualified alternative recommendation set. Nothing here proves that every future quantization or kernel is impossible. It closes these specific, predeclared practical routes and requires an honest statement of the remaining gap rather than more unchanged trials or a completion claim.
